what: Pan amplification on the 1-CPU box, offline (frontend/scripts/offline-backend/scn_sibling_toggle.js, the box modelled as processor sharing), the lead's 19:44Z pattern: z8 (-79.95, 26.5) on the owner's 844 x 390 window, 20 drifting pans 3 s apart, then until the client stops asking (DRAIN 15 s, cap 600 s). Builds of claude/series-pan-snap: PAN3 at 7a66ef36e (the pan guard + the settle reload guard; dev 4eac715a5 with #492 merged in); PAN2 at 4edaad0d3 (the pan guard without the reload guard). Arms: cur; guardonly (the five pan kill switches: only the reload guard on); before (all six kill switches = dev).
box_model: Surf asks at 1/5 of live cost so a run drains in minutes (live a 16-frame surf page is 10-25 s): COST_SURF_PAGE 3 s per 16 frames, COST_SURF_MINI 0.2 s, COST_SURF_GRID 0.2 s; swell asks at 4 s per 48-frame page, 0.3 s per mini, 0.4 s per /grid. Times are modelled; the requests, their kinds and order are the app's own.
